note: 2 workers, one per route family. Within-family rows share the handler registration region in internal/shim/opencode/server.go (handleMCPSub / pty subtree), so they are NOT mutually independent; the two families touch disjoint handler regions and spec surface rows, so family-level parallelism is the honest maximal wave. Each worker serves all 5 routes of its family per declared contracts, updates the served-surface rows, and regenerates declared-vs-served.
